mapper.select: SELECT FROM arch_standard_document ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM arch_standard_document WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=0
SELECT FROM arch_standard_document WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND row_version=#{rowVersion} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE arch_standard_document SET title=#{title},category_code=#{categoryCode},summary=#{summary},content=#{content},row_version=row_version+1,updated_by=#{operatorId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND row_version=#{rowVersion}

UPDATE arch_standard_document SET status='PUBLISHED',current_version=#{versionNo},published_at=NOW(3),published_by=#{operatorId},published_by_name=#{operatorName},row_version=row_version+1,updated_by=#{operatorId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND row_version=#{rowVersion}

UPDATE arch_standard_document SET status='OFFLINE',row_version=row_version+1,updated_by=#{operatorId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND status='PUBLISHED' AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
UPDATE arch_standard_document SET deleted=1,row_version=row_version+1,updated_by=#{operatorId} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=0 AND status='DRAFT' AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,document_id,version_no,title,category_code,summary,content,published_at,published_by,published_by_name FROM arch_standard_document_version WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND document_id=#{documentId} ORDER BY version_no DESC
